result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is my top overall recommendation.** It offers a great balance of competitive pricing, ease of integration, security, and room to grow.

However, the best choice depends on what platform your store uses.

## My top 5 payment processors

![Stripe Logo Download (SVG, PNG, EPS, PDF) | PixelBrands](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aVtuLxJXV9DmtEmg9b45Apl_aIYsif99dM-GHSfkXYZDC4tFOhFvFlTrHocFw_PqD4iGlfn8TyGj8Knz3iEfgQ88Gl1qbf-qVS8yq3s_dga8IuVvdS85dQWTHuxQAfDBHQSn4bvLAWea6XSgqDlmrU-sz5LlptntGZmOFqqabVil8_uydbbIqAvaqwgrj-k8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Standard online card fee: 2.9% + \$0.30
- No standard monthly processing fee
- Excellent fraud prevention and reporting
- Supports subscriptions and international payments

Best for WooCommerce, custom websites, and online-first businesses.

[Stripe website](https://stripe.com)

---

![Shopify Payments en México 2026: Comisiones y Cuándo Conviene | Atémpora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uaDWm9NONCBgwuJmZgfert_G31d46hLlI4IfJXvnluf3W2KNJh1m0Hd6lZrNGAPmsyHRrilMlk9B4682s-cn40d1cp-SjQrlAzuD2UEX8iNzkLVIhiPrHZ-Q-BYlhpFfZG8FNzWKzH1o7gk5YwcfdyrA6rRsIlL4g3Z9SJ_DAnqpO6UXb7hjSC1HIAun6cGh?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Starting online card rate: 2.9% + \$0.30 on Basic
- Integrated directly into Shopify
- No separate third-party payment provider needed
- Simplifies refunds and order management

Best if your store is already built on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments website](https://www.shopify.com/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

(Best for customer familiarity)

- Fees vary by checkout method
- Widely recognized by shoppers
- Offers PayPal, Venmo, and Pay Later options
- Easy to add to existing stores

Best as an additional checkout option alongside Stripe.

[PayPal Business website](https://www.paypal.com/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Free starting plan
- Online and in-person payments
- Inventory and point-of-sale tools
- Easy setup

Best if you also sell products at markets, events, or a physical shop.

[Square website](https://squareup.com/us/en)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Interchange-plus pricing
- No standard monthly fee
- Volume-based pricing advantages
- Useful for growing businesses

Best if you're processing enough transactions to benefit from negotiated processing costs.

[Helcim website](https://www.helcim.com)

Pricing is based on published U.S. standard rates; actual fees vary by transaction type, plan, and payment method. ## What I would choose

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Brand-new online store | Stripe |
| Shopify store | Shopify Payments |
| WooCommerce store | Stripe |
| Want customers to use PayPal | Add PayPal |
| Online and physical sales | Square |
| Higher transaction volume | Helcim |
